recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice and allow it to cool.
Stir-fry the vegetables.
Add egg, rice and soy sauce, then toss until hot.

recipes.name: Tomato Omelette
instructions: Whisk the eggs.
Cook the tomato until soft.
Add the egg and fold when set.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta.
Warm garlic in butter.
Toss with pasta and parmesan.

recipes.name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown the chicken.
Add chopped vegetables and water.
Simmer until tender.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Blend all ingredients.
Cook small portions in a lightly oiled pan.

recipes.name: Simple Shakshuka
instructions: Cook onion and garlic.
Add tomato and simmer.
Crack in eggs and cover until set.
